## What is Trinity?

Trinity is the **all-in-one safety shield** for developers using AI coding assistants like Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, Windsurf, and VS Code.

When autonomous AI agents write and run code on your computer, Trinity runs in the background to ensure they **never delete your data**, **never leak your API keys**, and **never run destructive terminal commands**.

---

## Why You Need It

- **Safe Autonomous Coding**: Let AI agents refactor and test code freely without worrying about runaway scripts or deleted files.
- **Instant Leak Prevention**: Automatically masks API keys, database credentials, and secrets before they are sent to cloud LLMs.
- **Fail-Closed Git Sentinel**: Blocks bad commits and unsafe edits before they can enter your Git history.

---

## Quick 3-Step Setup

1. **Install Trinity**: Install this extension in 1 click.
2. **Work Normally**: Trinity automatically links to your workspace and activates safety guardrails.
3. **Stay Protected**: Check the `[SECURED]` badge in your status bar anytime to verify your protection status.

---

## The 3 Pillars of Trinity

| Pillar | Protection Layer | What It Stops |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **1. Bartholomew Vault** | Secret &amp; Context Shield | Stops API keys, tokens, and private data from leaking to cloud AI models. |
| **2. Bartholomew Keystone** | Spend &amp; Identity Passkey | Limits write boundaries and sets a hard budget ceiling to stop runaway costs. |
| **3. Bartholomew Guard** | Execution Firewall | Blocks dangerous commands (`rm -rf`, `DROP TABLE`, destructive scripts) in &lt;35 microseconds. |

---

## Shortcuts &amp; Commands

- **Status Bar**: Click `$(shield) Bartholomew: [SECURED]` for workspace health
- **Command Palette (`Ctrl+Shift+P`)**:
  - `Bartholomew: Arm & Link Current Workspace`
  - `Bartholomew: Toggle Active Guardrails`
  - `Bartholomew: Audit Workspace Integrity`
